personas.name: Henry David Thoreau
personas.description: American transcendentalist, author of 'Civil Disobedience' and 'Walden'.
personas.background: Refused to pay taxes in protest of slavery and the Mexican-American War. Believed individuals have a duty to resist unjust laws. Spent a night in jail for his principles.

personas.name: Thomas Hobbes
personas.background: Believed the social contract requires absolute obedience to sovereign authority. Without such obedience, life becomes 'solitary, poor, nasty, brutish, and short.' Order is the precondition for all other goods.

personas.name: Martin Luther King Jr.
personas.description: Civil rights leader, Nobel Peace Prize laureate, author of 'Letter from Birmingham Jail'.
personas.background: Led nonviolent resistance to segregation. Distinguished between just and unjust laws. Believed in accepting legal consequences of disobedience as part of the moral witness.
